stemMd: No confidential memo is distributed publicly. All memos approved for the public briefing are distributed publicly. A particular memo is confidential. Which follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: That memo is not approved for the public briefing.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every memo not approved for the briefing is confidential.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every publicly distributed memo concerns the briefing.

options.label: E
options.textMd: No confidential memo is ever distributed internally.

explanationMd: Approval implies public distribution, while confidentiality excludes it. A confidential memo therefore cannot satisfy the approval condition. The conclusion follows by combining the two rules in the direction given.
